# Semantic Scholar

> AI-powered scholarly search and discovery platform with paper, author, citation, and developer API access.

Semantic Scholar, from the Allen Institute for AI, helps researchers discover and understand scientific literature using machine learning, citation data, and structured scholarly metadata. The site combines a research interface for finding papers and authors with developer tools for accessing the Academic Graph API.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://www.semanticscholar.org/): Main entry point for AI-powered search and discovery of scientific literature.
- [Product](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product): Overview of Semantic Scholar features for finding, reading, and tracking research.
- [Semantic Reader](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/semantic-reader): Augmented reading experience for scientific papers with inline references and media.
- [Scholar's Hub](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/scholars-hub): Curated research discovery space for trending and notable scholarly papers.
- [Tutorials](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/tutorials): Product walkthroughs and videos for using Semantic Scholar effectively.
- [Beta Program](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/beta-program): Information about testing experimental Semantic Scholar features and updates.

## Search and Discovery
- [Search](https://www.semanticscholar.org/search): Search interface for papers, authors, topics, and research results.
- [Research Feeds](https://www.semanticscholar.org/feed): Personalized feed of papers and recommendations based on interests.
- [Author Profiles](https://www.semanticscholar.org/author): Entry point for browsing researcher profiles and publication records.
- [Paper Pages](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper): Canonical paper pages with abstracts, citations, references, and metadata.
- [Topics](https://www.semanticscholar.org/topic): Topic pages for exploring research areas and related literature.

## API and Developer Docs
- [API Overview](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api): Overview of the Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API and developer access.
- [API Tutorial](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api/tutorial): Getting started guide for making requests to the Academic Graph API.
- [API Gallery](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api/gallery): Examples and showcase of projects built with Semantic Scholar API data.
- [API Documentation](https://api.semanticscholar.org/api-docs/graph): Reference documentation for Academic Graph API endpoints and schemas.
- [API Docs Home](https://api.semanticscholar.org/api-docs/): Landing page for Semantic Scholar API documentation.
- [API Status](https://status.api.semanticscholar.org/): Operational status and incident reporting for Semantic Scholar API services.

## API Reference
- [Graph API](https://api.semanticscholar.org/api-docs/graph): Main reference for papers, authors, citations, and search endpoints.
- [Datasets API](https://api.semanticscholar.org/api-docs/datasets): Reference for dataset release metadata and download-related endpoints.
- [Recommendations API](https://api.semanticscholar.org/api-docs/recommendations): Reference for paper recommendation endpoints based on seed papers.
- [API Introduction](https://api.semanticscholar.org/api-docs/graph#tag/Introduction): Introductory information, authentication, and usage basics.
- [Paper Endpoints](https://api.semanticscholar.org/api-docs/graph#tag/Paper-Data): Reference for retrieving paper metadata and related entities.
- [Author Endpoints](https://api.semanticscholar.org/api-docs/graph#tag/Author-Data): Reference for author profiles, publications, and author search.
- [Dataset Releases](https://api.semanticscholar.org/api-docs/datasets#tag/Datasets): Reference for listing and accessing Semantic Scholar dataset releases.

## Datasets and Research Data
- [Datasets API](https://api.semanticscholar.org/api-docs/datasets): Programmatic access to Semantic Scholar dataset release information.
- [S2AG](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api): Product page describing access to the Semantic Scholar Academic Graph.
- [API Legal](https://api.semanticscholar.org/corpus/legal): Legal terms and usage information for corpus and API access.
- [Open Data Access](https://api.semanticscholar.org/): Entry point for Semantic Scholar developer-facing API services.

## Help and Support
- [FAQ](https://www.semanticscholar.org/faq): Frequently asked questions about accounts, search, papers, and platform behavior.
- [API FAQ](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api): Common developer questions are addressed from the API overview page.
- [Tutorials](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/tutorials): Learning resources for using search, alerts, and reading features.
- [Librarian Resources](https://www.semanticscholar.org/about/librarians): Information for librarians supporting researchers using Semantic Scholar.

## About Semantic Scholar
- [About](https://www.semanticscholar.org/about): Mission, background, and organizational context for Semantic Scholar and AI2.
- [Careers](https://www.semanticscholar.org/about/careers): Employment opportunities related to Semantic Scholar and its parent organization.
- [Publishers](https://www.semanticscholar.org/about/publishers): Information for publishing partners and content relationships.
- [Librarians](https://www.semanticscholar.org/about/librarians): Resources for libraries and institutions using Semantic Scholar.
- [AI2](https://allenai.org/): Parent research institute behind Semantic Scholar and related AI projects.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://www.semanticscholar.org/terms): Terms governing use of the Semantic Scholar website and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.semanticscholar.org/privacy): Privacy practices for accounts, usage data, and platform interactions.

- [Cookie Policy](https://www.semanticscholar.org/privacy): Privacy page covering data and cookie-related practices.
